intro: Your friends hid 5 treasures around this house. Point your camera around, follow the clues, and find them all. Something special is waiting at the finish line.

targets.name: The jacket hooks
targets.clue: Every driver needs their team kit. Find where the gear hangs between races.
targets.hint: Check the hooks. Look for something white with red stripes.

targets.name: The Lego key board
targets.clue: Tiny drivers park here, guarding the thing you need to get out the door.
targets.hint: A grey baseplate on the wall, with keys hanging from it.

targets.name: The Lego calendar boat
targets.clue: Count the days! Find the brick-built boat that keeps track of the date.
targets.hint: A dragon boat with a flip calendar, sitting on a wooden shelf.

targets.name: The champion’s helmet
targets.clue: Protect the champion’s head! Find the bright yellow lid built brick by brick.
targets.hint: A Lego helmet on a white shelf, with little red cars parked nearby.

targets.name: The road trip map
targets.clue: Every great road trip starts with a map. Find the one made piece by piece.
targets.hint: It’s a jigsaw puzzle. Point the camera at the middle of it.

reveal.headline: LIGHTS OUT!
reveal.message: Happy Birthday, Sajid! Pack your bags, you’re going to Vegas! 🏁
